source.title: Floral scent in food-deceptive orchids: species specificity and sources of variability

quote: The abstract reports 35 floral scent compounds, mainly monoterpenes, shared by both species.
note: Abstract record read through the Pherobase literature page; individual compounds not named there. Emission is what the flower sends out; the plant's own detection of volatiles is not measured.

value: foliage emitted seven monoterpenes; alpha-pinene, beta-pinene and 3-carene made up about 80% of the total; proportions differed among provenances (mountain trees mostly more than 40% alpha-pinene; 3-carene absent in western trees)
method: headspace of current-year twigs incubated at 30 C for 15 min, gas-liquid chromatography
conditions: 6-8 twigs from each of ten trees per site
